traditional: A 同 B 一樣高
jyutping: A tung4 B jat1 joeng6 gou1

english.note: Use this construction when one object is at the same height as a reference object or line.

examples.english: This table is level with that one.
examples.traditional: 呢張枱同嗰張枱一樣高。
